component.name: ibm-watson-speech-to-text
component.title: IBM Watson Speech to Text
component.description: Transcribe audio to text with IBM Watson Speech to Text, and list or get its speech models and custom language models.
component.label: ai,cloud

configuration.description: The shared configuration of the endpoints. Each endpoint starts from a copy of it, and its endpoint options override the values.

serviceUrl.label: common
serviceUrl.description: The URL of the Speech to Text service instance, for example https://api.eu-de.speech-to-text.watson.cloud.ibm.com. If not set, the IBM Watson SDK uses https://api.us-south.speech-to-text.watson.cloud.ibm.com, unless its external configuration, such as the SPEECH_TO_TEXT_URL environment variable, gives a URL.

contentType.label: producer
contentType.description: The format (MIME type) of the audio for recognize, for example audio/wav, audio/flac, audio/mp3, audio/ogg or audio/webm. audio/l16, audio/alaw and audio/mulaw also need the sampling rate, as in audio/l16;rate=16000, and application/octet-stream lets the service detect the format. The CamelIBMWatsonSTTContentType header replaces this option.

lazyStartProducer.label: producer
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

model.label: producer
model.description: The speech model that recognize uses, for example en-US_Multimedia or en-GB_Telephony. The sampling rate of the audio must be at least 16 kHz for a broadband or multimedia model and 8 kHz for a narrowband or telephony model. The CamelIBMWatsonSTTModel header replaces this option.

operation.label: producer
operation.description: The operation that the producer performs: recognize transcribes audio, listModels and getModel return the speech models, and listCustomModels and getCustomModel the custom language models. The CamelIBMWatsonSTTOperation header replaces this option, and the producer fails if neither is set.

speakerLabels.label: producer
speakerLabels.description: Whether recognize returns labels that identify which speaker spoke which words. The service then also returns the timestamps of the words, whatever the timestamps option is. The CamelIBMWatsonSTTSpeakerLabels header replaces this option.

timestamps.label: producer
timestamps.description: Whether recognize returns the start and end time of each word, in seconds. The CamelIBMWatsonSTTTimestamps header replaces this option.

wordConfidence.label: producer
wordConfidence.description: Whether recognize returns a confidence score from 0.0 to 1.0 for each word. The CamelIBMWatsonSTTWordConfidence header replaces this option.

autowiredEnabled.label: advanced
autowiredEnabled.description: Whether autowiring is enabled. This is used for automatic autowiring options (the option must be marked as autowired) by looking up in the registry to find if there is a single instance of matching type, which then gets configured on the component. This can be used for automatic configuring JDBC data sources, JMS connection factories, AWS Clients, etc.

healthCheckConsumerEnabled.label: health
healthCheckConsumerEnabled.description: Used for enabling or disabling all consumer based health checks from this component

healthCheckProducerEnabled.label: health
healthCheckProducerEnabled.description: Used for enabling or disabling all producer based health checks from this component. Notice: Camel has by default disabled all producer based health-checks. You can turn on producer checks globally by setting camel.health.producersEnabled=true.

apiKey.label: security
apiKey.description: The IBM Cloud API key of the Speech to Text service instance. The client gets IAM access tokens with it. The endpoint fails to start without it.

CamelIBMWatsonSTTOperation.description: The operation that the producer performs. It replaces the operation option.

CamelIBMWatsonSTTAudioFile.description: The audio file that recognize transcribes. If set, the producer sends this file instead of the message body.

CamelIBMWatsonSTTModel.description: The speech model that recognize uses. It replaces the model option. The producer sets it on the result to the model it used.

CamelIBMWatsonSTTContentType.description: The format (MIME type) of the audio for recognize. It replaces the contentType option. The producer sets it on the result to the format it sent.

CamelIBMWatsonSTTTimestamps.description: Whether recognize returns the start and end time of each word. It replaces the timestamps option.

CamelIBMWatsonSTTWordConfidence.description: Whether recognize returns a confidence score for each word. It replaces the wordConfidence option.

CamelIBMWatsonSTTSpeakerLabels.description: Whether recognize returns labels that identify the speaker of each word. It replaces the speakerLabels option.

CamelIBMWatsonSTTModelName.description: The name of the speech model for getModel, or the customization ID of the custom language model for getCustomModel. If not set, the producer reads it from the message body.

CamelIBMWatsonSTTLanguage.description: The language for listCustomModels, for example en-US, to list only the custom language models of that language. If not set, all custom language models of the service instance are listed.

CamelIBMWatsonSTTTranscript.description: The transcript that recognize sets: the text of the first alternative of each result, joined in order.

producerIn.description: The audio to recognize in the format of contentType (audio/wav by default), as bytes, a stream or a file, unless the CamelIBMWatsonSTTAudioFile header gives a file. No body or a Map fails, and text is sent as its bytes. getModel and getCustomModel read the model name or ID as text unless the CamelIBMWatsonSTTModelName header gives it

producerOut.description: recognize gives the SpeechRecognitionResults of the IBM Watson SDK, with the transcript as text in the CamelIBMWatsonSTTTranscript header. Converted to text, it is the JSON of the results. listModels gives a List of SpeechModel and listCustomModels a List of LanguageModel

label.description: A logical name for the endpoint, for example to tell endpoints apart. The component does not use it.
